answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every identity to post a small time-locked stake — copper, not gold — that is slashed on proven misbehavior. Spinning up a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand stakes, so a whisper campaign gets expensive fast while honest agents pay once and keep trading. Reputation accrues only to staked identities, and trust must be earned through verifiable work, like shale forming slowly under sustained pressure rather than appearing overnight.
